questions.question: There is water dripping from the bathroom ceiling and the floor is flooded. This started this morning and is getting worse.
The water pipe under my kitchen sink is leaking slowly. Small drips onto the cabinet floor.
My toilet has been running constantly for two days and will not stop. Wasting a lot of water.
Sparks are coming from the electrical outlet near my bathroom. There is a burning smell and I am worried about fire.
The fuse box in my apartment keeps tripping. Lights go out every few hours. Burning smell from the panel.
One light switch in the bedroom does not work. The bulb is fine but the switch feels loose.
My front door lock is broken and does not latch properly. Anyone could open it from outside.
I saw a stranger in the hallway who appeared to be trying to open my neighbour's door. Suspicious activity.
The common area hallway lights are all out. It is completely dark at night and feels unsafe.
There is garbage and dirt in the hallway outside my apartment that has not been cleaned in weeks. Strong smell.
Pest infestation — cockroaches visible in kitchen. Needs professional extermination immediately.
My internet has been down for three days. I work from home and this is urgent. Router shows no connection.
WiFi is very slow in my apartment. Streaming videos keeps buffering. Speed tests show 2 Mbps.
The air conditioning is not working. Temperature inside is 32 degrees Celsius and rising. I have elderly family members.
The heating system is making loud banging noises at night. Hot water radiators keep clanking and disturb sleep.
There is a large crack appearing in my bedroom wall. It was not there last month and seems to be growing.
The ceiling in my living room has a visible sag and some tiles have fallen. Looks like water damage weakened the structure.
I have a general question about apartment rules regarding parking in the guest spaces on weekends.
Water is leaking from the bathroom ceiling AND sparks are coming from the nearby power outlet. Possible electrical hazard near water source.
The kitchen tap drips very slowly. Not a big issue but has been going for about a month.
